context:
她們如果不是真的我就是假的！

由於這是雙方同步生配信本色出演
我還重聽了幾次來抓兩邊的時間軸

🌸配信時⋯
🌸突然意識到👾辦的瑪利歐賽車與瑪利歐派對大賽的日子近了

🌸：不練習可不行啊，糟了！誰願意陪🌸練習呢？只要一天就行，🌸都是臨時抱佛腳的！（這時🌸打起了Line)
🌸：誒抖⋯瑪利歐賽車和⋯瑪利歐派對⋯的練習⋯這週⋯陪我練⋯（自言自語中）

同一時間，☄️正在開X的SPACE。
☄️：（正在聊其他話題，Line提示音此時響了）？⋯瑪利歐賽車和瑪利歐派對的練習，這週陪我練？好～（回Line) 是Line傳來的訊息~

回到🌸這頭：
🌸：對方說OK了！嗯抖⋯(又發了Line)

再來☄️這裡：
（繼續聊其他話題，此時💬開始在問是誰在傳訊息）
☄️：誰傳的？（聲音突然變可愛）那⋯會是誰呢？嗯⋯是誰呢⋯？誰傳的呢⋯？不知道呢！⋯？傳了「壽司🍣」給我！⋯？？壽司是啥啊⋯？

編按：這個🍣，八成是🌸太高興了，想寫「喜歡」（すき，suki）但是因為意識到自己還在配信不能表達的那麼直接，就寫了「壽司」（すし，sushi）！

If they aren’t real, then I must be fake!

Since both sides were live streaming and acting as themselves,
I even replayed it a few times to match their timelines.

🌸 During the stream…
🌸 Suddenly realized that the Mario Kart and Mario Party tournaments organized by 👾 were coming up soon.

🌸: “I need to practice! Oh no! Who can practice with me? Just one day is enough. I like cramming at last minute!” (At this point, 🌸 started messaging on Line.)
🌸: “Umm… Mario Kart and… Mario Party… practice… this week… practice with me…” (mumbling to herself)

At the same time, ☄️ was hosting a Space on X.
☄️: (talking about other topics, Line notification sound went off) “…Mario Kart and Mario Party practice this week? Practice with me? Okay~” (replies on Line). “It was a message from Line~”

Back to 🌸’s side:
🌸: “She said OK! Umm… (sends another Line message).”

Now over to ☄️:
(continues chatting about other topics; 💬starts asking who’s messaging her)
☄️: “Who messaged me?” (suddenly speaking in a cute voice) “Who could it be? Hmm… Who is it? Who sent that? No idea! …? Wait she sent me ‘sushi 🍣’! …?? Sushi? What’s that about…?”

Editor’s note: That 🍣 was probably because 🌸 was so happy and wanted to write “like” (すき, suki) but realized they were still live streaming and couldn’t express it that directly. So instead, she wrote “sushi” (すし, sushi)!
